card.name: Letters inside codes and IDs
card.fires_on: A single letter that sits right after digits inside an identifier, such as a URL number, document number, room number, hex color or model code. It is usually a trailing letter such as a, d, A or E.

modes.label: Letter ending a URL or reference ID
modes.description: A lone letter follows digits in a web address or DOI before the rest of the string.

modes.label: Letter suffix on a numbered item
modes.description: A capital letter follows a number in a document, room or mutation label.
